title: Our agreement with the Department of War
summary: Details on OpenAI’s contract with the Department of War, outlining safety red lines, legal protections, and how AI systems will be deployed in classified environments.
body: Details on OpenAI’s contract with the Department of War, outlining safety red lines, legal protections, and how AI systems will be deployed in classified environments.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布与国防部门达成协议，详细规定了AI系统在机密环境下的部署准则。该协议重点涵盖了安全红线设定、法律保护机制以及在国防场景下的具体应用规范，标志着大模型技术在国家安全领域应用合规性的重要进展。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与国防部门签署协议，明确了AI在敏感环境下的部署规范与安全红线。

glossary.explanationZh: 指在AI部署中必须严格遵守的安全边界和限制条件。
指涉及国家机密或高度敏感信息的受限计算环境。
